## Q. How do I exclude the streamer from omikuji?


You can do this by creating an "admin settings" entry in Comment Events.

1. In OmikujiBot Editor, open Comment Events and click the + Add button to create a new event.
2. Open the new event, then open Trigger Settings.
3. Under "Trigger Condition to Apply", select "User Role" and check the "Streamer" box.
4. Under "Omikuji Settings", select any omikuji item.
5. Under "Action", select `Special Action`.
6. Under "Special Action Type", select `End Processing`.
